newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul stock exchange to list appliances firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul stock exchange to list appliances firm.

text.p: Turkish electronic household appliances producer Ihlas Ev Aletleri Imalat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. will be listed on the regional markets of the Istanbul Stock Exchange, an exchange statement said.
The shares will start trading on October 7 at a price of 13,000 lira for each 1,000 lira nominal-valued share, it said.

Garanti Yatirim Bankasi, the leader of arrangers, said that the total offer of 22.5 billion lira nominal value shares had been sold to 1,297 individual domestic buyers during the two-day offer on September 26-27.
Ihlas Holding owns 40.56 percent of the firm's 90 billion lira capital after the public sale.
The firm produces about 30 different types of electronic household appliances including electric heaters, water heaters, small kitchenware appliances and hair dryers.
Its net profit was 26.5 billion lira and turnover was 1.23 trillion lira in the first half of 1996.
